from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class PaperCitationInfo(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single provided paper regarding its references."""
    title: str = Field(description="The full title of the paper being parsed")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the OTHER provided papers (known from the task context) that appear in this paper's reference list")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[PaperCitationInfo]
